text: Perhaps a corpse would be re-animated; galvanism had given token of such things.
speaker: Mary Shelley

text: Invention, it must be humbly admitted, does not consist in creating out of void, but out of chaos…
speaker: Mary Shelley

text: Learn from me, if not by my precepts, at least by my example, how dangerous is the acquirement of knowledge…
speaker: Victor Frankenstein

text: It was on a dreary night of November, that I beheld the accomplishment of my toils.
speaker: Victor Frankenstein

text: I was benevolent and good; misery made me a fiend.
speaker: The creature

text: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.
speaker: The creature
